title: Switch Sensor
body: I would like to see a new Functionality "switch sensor". I do presoak my g5 sensors and after around 24 hours I usually stop the old one and start the new sensor. For this to work, I do need to type in the new Sensor Id and wait 15min to get 3 initial readings. It would be great, if I do not need to type the sensor Id and it would be better if I could start the new sensor directly without the wait period of 15mins.

comments.body:
